families.evidence: Game::InitializeCallbackStateMachine writes native records/callbacks/rules. Game::UpdateInRaceCallbackMachine owns two slots after the machine. Callback tables supply the same machine to race/menu handlers. Race_EnterCurrentModeScene saves its pointer in scratch slot 5; slots 0..4 carry bounded numeric states/cursors. See docs/structure-recovery/64bit-race-state-pointers.md.
